statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); dir="${cwd/#$HOME/~}"; branch=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); out=$(printf '\033[34m%s\033[0m' "$dir"); [ -n "$branch" ] && out="$out $(printf '\033[32m %s\033[0m' "$branch")"; out="$out $(printf '\033[2m%s\033[0m' "$model")"; used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); [ -n "$used" ] && out="$out $(printf '\033[2mctx:%.0f%%\033[0m' "$used")"; echo "$out"
